local Config = {
    FOVSize = 180,
    HitPart = "Head",
    MaxFlightTicks = 100,
    FullDrawTicks = 20,
}

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Client = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("Client")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")

local BowController = require(Client:WaitForChild("BowController"))
local CombatClient = require(Client:WaitForChild("CombatClient"))
local FirstPersonAnimationModule = Client:WaitForChild("FirstPersonAnimation")
local FirstPersonAnimation = require(FirstPersonAnimationModule)
local TaCZMotion = require(FirstPersonAnimationModule:WaitForChild("TaCZMotion"))
local BowMath = require(Shared:WaitForChild("BowMath"))
local BowNet = require(Shared:WaitForChild("BowNet"))
local BowConfig = require(Shared:WaitForChild("BowConfig"))
local CharacterLife = require(Shared:WaitForChild("CharacterLife"))

local ActiveRelease = nil
local ActivePreview = nil
local ActiveDrawingController = nil
local CachedDraws = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

if Drawing and type(Drawing.new) == "function" then
    local FovCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
    FovCircle.Position = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    FovCircle.Visible = true
    FovCircle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    FovCircle.Radius = Config.FOVSize
    FovCircle.Transparency = 1
    FovCircle.Filled = false
    FovCircle.NumSides = 64

    RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
        FovCircle.Position = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    end)
end

local function FindTarget()
    local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera then
        return nil
    end

    local Mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local BestPart = nil
    local BestDistance = Config.FOVSize
    local InfectionMode = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("MatchMode") == "Infection"

    local function Consider(Character, Player)
        if not Character or Character.Name == "DeathModel" then
            return
        end
        if InfectionMode then
            local RoleSource = Player or Character
            if RoleSource:GetAttribute("InfectionRole") ~= "Zombie" then
                return
            end
        end
        if Player and Player:GetAttribute("MatchStatus") == "Dead" then
            return
        end

        local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not Humanoid
            or CharacterLife.isDead(Humanoid)
            or Humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
        then
            return
        end

        local Part = Character:FindFirstChild(Config.HitPart)
        if not Part or not Part:IsA("BasePart") then
            return
        end

        local Screen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Part.Position)
        if Screen.Z <= 0 then
            return
        end

        local Distance = (Vector2.new(Screen.X, Screen.Y) - Mouse).Magnitude
        if Distance >= BestDistance then
            return
        end

        BestDistance = Distance
        BestPart = Part
    end

    for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
        if Player == LocalPlayer then
            continue
        end

        Consider(Player.Character, Player)
    end

    local Bots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Bots")
    if Bots then
        for _, Bot in Bots:GetChildren() do
            if not Bot:IsA("Model") then
                continue
            end

            Consider(Bot)
        end
    end

    return BestPart
end

local function SolveDirection(Controller, Origin, ChargeTicks, Target)
    local Seed = Controller.network and Controller.network.bowSeed
    local DrawId = Controller.drawId
    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local Root = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not Seed or not DrawId or not Root or not Target or ChargeTicks == nil then
        return nil, "missing seed, draw ID, character root, target, or charge"
    end

    local Power = BowMath.powerTicks(ChargeTicks)
    if Power < 0.1 then
        return nil, "draw charge is below launch threshold"
    end

    local Effects = Controller.drawEffects
    local SpeedBonus = 1 + (Effects and Effects.ArrowSpeedBonus or 0)
    local Speed = BowMath.f32(Power * 3 * SpeedBonus)
    if Speed <= 0 then
        return nil, "launch speed is zero"
    end

    local Spread = BowMath.launchSpread(BowNet.random(Seed, DrawId))
    local Source = BowMath.fromWorld(BowNet.clampVelocity(Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity) * BowConfig.Tick)
    local OriginBlocks = BowMath.fromWorld(Origin)
    local TargetVelocity = Target.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local Drag = BowMath.AirInertia

    local function Candidate(Ticks)
        local Sum = (1 - Drag ^ Ticks) / (1 - Drag)
        local GravityDrop = 0.05 * (Ticks - Sum) / (1 - Drag)
        local Future = Target.Position + TargetVelocity * (Ticks * BowConfig.Tick)
        local Destination = BowMath.fromWorld(Future)
        local Delta = Vector3.new(
            Destination.x - OriginBlocks.x,
            Destination.y - OriginBlocks.y,
            Destination.z - OriginBlocks.z
        )
        local RequiredVelocity = Vector3.new(
            Delta.X / Sum,
            (Delta.Y + GravityDrop) / Sum,
            Delta.Z / Sum
        )
        local Aim = Vector3.new(
            (RequiredVelocity.X - Source.x) / Speed - Spread.x,
            RequiredVelocity.Y / Speed - Spread.y,
            (RequiredVelocity.Z - Source.z) / Speed - Spread.z
        )
        return Aim, Aim.Magnitude - 1
    end

    local PreviousTicks = 0.25
    local _, PreviousError = Candidate(PreviousTicks)
    local BestAim = nil
    local BestTicks = nil
    local BestError = math.huge

    for Ticks = 0.5, Config.MaxFlightTicks, 0.5 do
        local Aim, Error = Candidate(Ticks)
        if math.abs(Error) < BestError then
            BestAim = Aim
            BestTicks = Ticks
            BestError = math.abs(Error)
        end

        if PreviousError > 0 and Error <= 0 then
            local Low, High = PreviousTicks, Ticks
            for _ = 1, 18 do
                local Mid = (Low + High) * 0.5
                local _, MidError = Candidate(Mid)
                if MidError > 0 then
                    Low = Mid
                else
                    High = Mid
                end
            end
            Aim = Candidate((Low + High) * 0.5)
            if Aim.Magnitude > 0 then
                return Aim.Unit, nil, {
                    FlightTicks = (Low + High) * 0.5,
                    Power = Power,
                    Speed = Speed,
                    Spread = Spread,
                    Source = Source,
                    Fallback = false,
                }
            end
            return nil, "aim vector is zero"
        end

        PreviousTicks = Ticks
        PreviousError = Error
    end

    if not BestAim or BestAim.Magnitude <= 0 then
        return nil, "no usable trajectory"
    end

    return BestAim.Unit, nil, {
        FlightTicks = BestTicks,
        Power = Power,
        Speed = Speed,
        Spread = Spread,
        Source = Source,
        Fallback = true,
        Residual = BestError,
    }
end

local OldChargeTicks
OldChargeTicks = hookfunction(BowNet.chargeTicks, function(...)
    local Ticks = OldChargeTicks(...)
    if ActiveRelease then
        ActiveRelease.ChargeTicks = Ticks
    end
    return Ticks
end)

local OldRandom
OldRandom = hookfunction(BowNet.random, function(Seed, DrawId)
    local Controller = ActivePreview
    if not Controller or (type(Seed) == "number" and type(DrawId) == "number") then
        return OldRandom(Seed, DrawId)
    end

    local Cached = CachedDraws[Controller]
    local CurrentId = Controller.drawId
    if type(CurrentId) ~= "number" and Cached then
        CurrentId = Cached.Id
    end

    if type(Seed) == "number" and type(CurrentId) == "number" then
        DrawId = CurrentId
        Controller.previewDrawId = DrawId
        return OldRandom(Seed, DrawId)
    end

    Controller.trajectory:hide()
    return function()
        return 0.5
    end
end)

local OldPreviewTrajectory
OldPreviewTrajectory = hookfunction(BowController.previewTrajectory, function(Controller, ...)
    if Controller.drawing and (not Controller.network or type(Controller.network.bowSeed) ~= "number") then
        Controller.trajectory:hide()
        return
    end

    if Controller.drawing and type(Controller.drawId) ~= "number" then
        local Cached = CachedDraws[Controller]
        if Cached and type(Cached.Id) == "number" then
            Controller.drawId = Cached.Id
        else
            Controller.trajectory:hide()
            return
        end
    end

    local Previous = ActivePreview
    ActivePreview = Controller
    local Result = OldPreviewTrajectory(Controller, ...)
    ActivePreview = Previous
    return Result
end)

local OldLaunchPoint
OldLaunchPoint = hookfunction(BowController.launchPoint, function(Controller, ...)
    local Origin, Direction = OldLaunchPoint(Controller, ...)
    local State = ActiveRelease
    local IsRelease = State and State.Controller == Controller
    local IsPreview = ActivePreview == Controller and Controller.drawing
    if not IsRelease and not IsPreview then
        return Origin, Direction
    end

    local Target = FindTarget()
    if not Target then
        return Origin, Direction
    end

    local ChargeTicks = if IsRelease then State.ChargeTicks else Controller.previewTicks
    local Aim = SolveDirection(Controller, Origin, ChargeTicks, Target)
    if Aim then
        if IsRelease then
            State.Direction = Aim
            State.Origin = Origin
        end
        return Origin, Aim
    end
    return Origin, Direction
end)

local OldSend
OldSend = hookfunction(CombatClient.send, function(Network, Action, Params)
    local State = ActiveRelease
    local Matched = Action == "Release" and State and State.Controller.network == Network
    if Matched and State.Direction then
        Params.direction = State.Direction
        Params.origin = State.Origin
    end
    local Result = OldSend(Network, Action, Params)
    if Action == "Draw" and Network.controller then
        CachedDraws[Network.controller] = {Id = Result}
    end
    return Result
end)

local OldBeginDraw
OldBeginDraw = hookfunction(BowController.beginDraw, function(Controller, ...)
    local WasDrawing = Controller.drawing
    local Result = OldBeginDraw(Controller, ...)
    if WasDrawing or not Controller.drawing then
        return Result
    end

    ActiveDrawingController = Controller
    return Result
end)

local OldAnimationUpdate
OldAnimationUpdate = hookfunction(FirstPersonAnimation.update, function(Animation, Delta, Slot, Drawing, DrawTicks, ...)
    local Controller = ActiveDrawingController
    if Controller and Controller.firstPersonAnimation == Animation and Drawing and Slot == 1 then
        DrawTicks = math.max(DrawTicks, Config.FullDrawTicks)
    end

    return OldAnimationUpdate(Animation, Delta, Slot, Drawing, DrawTicks, ...)
end)

local OldMotionUpdate
OldMotionUpdate = hookfunction(TaCZMotion.update, function(Motion, Delta, Drawing, DrawTicks, ...)
    local Result = OldMotionUpdate(Motion, Delta, Drawing, DrawTicks, ...)
    local Controller = ActiveDrawingController
    if Controller and Controller.firstPersonAnimation.tacz == Motion and Drawing and Motion.key == "tb23" then
        local Track = Motion.adsTrack
        if Track and Track.name == "pull_in" then
            Track.start = math.min(Track.start, Motion.clock - 0.2)
        end
    end

    return Result
end)

local OldRelease
OldRelease = hookfunction(BowController.release, function(Controller, ...)
    local Previous = ActiveRelease
    local State = {Controller = Controller}
    ActiveRelease = State
    local Result = OldRelease(Controller, ...)
    ActiveRelease = Previous
    return Result
end)

local function normalizeId(raw)
    raw = (raw or ""):gsub("%s+", "")
    if raw == "" then return nil end
    if tonumber(raw) then
        return "rbxassetid://" .. raw

    if raw:match("^rbxassetid://") then return raw end
    if raw:match("^https?://") then
        local id = raw:match("(%d+)")
        if id then return "rbxassetid://" .. id end
    end
    return raw
end

local function ensureSound()
    if state.sound and state.sound.Parent then return state.sound end
    local s = Instance.new("Sound")
    s.Name = "BoomboxSound"
    s.Looped = state.looped
    s.Volume = state.volume
    s.PlaybackSpeed = state.speed
    s.Pitch = state.pitch
    s.Parent = SoundService
    state.sound = s
    return s
end

local function stopSound()
    if state.sound then
        state.sound:Stop()
        state.sound:Destroy()
        state.sound = nil
    end
    state.playing = false
end

local function playSound()
    if state.soundId == "" then
        setStatus("Enter a music id first.")
        return
    end
    stopSound()
    local s = ensureSound()
    s.SoundId = state.soundId
    s.Volume = state.volume
    s.PlaybackSpeed = state.speed
    s.Pitch = state.pitch
    s.Looped = state.looped
    local ok, err = pcall(function() s:Play() end)
    if not ok then
        setStatus("Playback failed.")
        return
    end
    state.playing = true
    setStatus("Playing.")
end

local function pauseSound()
    if state.sound and state.playing then
        state.sound:Pause()
        state.playing = false
        setStatus("Paused.")
    end
end

local function resumeSound()
    if state.sound and not state.playing then

        state.playing = true
        setStatus("Resumed.")

end

    "rootjoint", "torso", "head", "limb", "humanoidrootpart",

local CAP_OPTIONS = { 25, 50, 150, 300, 600, 1500 }
local MAX_ITEM_SIZE = 60 -- anything bigger is treated as map geometry
local SKIP_NEAR = 12     -- items already this close to you are skipped

local S = {
    capIndex = 2,
    includeAnchored = false,
    autoCategory = "all",
    autoDelay = 3,
    perf = false,
    campOffset = 3,
}

-- =========================================================
-- NAME MATCHING (whole words only)
-- =========================================================
local tokenCache, tokenCacheCount = {}, 0
local function tokenize(name)
    local cached = tokenCache[name]
    if cached then return cached end
    -- "StrongAxe" -> "strong axe", "raw_meat" -> "raw meat"
    local s = name:gsub("(%l)(%u)", "%1 %2"):gsub("[^%w]+", " "):lower()
    local tokens = {}
    for w in s:gmatch("%S+") do tokens[#tokens + 1] = w end
    if tokenCacheCount > 20000 then tokenCache, tokenCacheCount = {}, 0 end
    tokenCache[name] = tokens
    tokenCacheCount += 1
    return tokens
end

local function matchesSet(name, set)
    for _, t in ipairs(tokenize(name)) do
        if set[t] then return true end
        if t:sub(-1) == "s" and set[t:sub(1, -2)] then return true end -- plurals
    end
    return false
end

local function matchesCategory(name, cat)
    if cat == "all" then
        for _, c in ipairs(CATEGORY_ORDER) do
            if matchesSet(name, CATEGORIES[c]) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    return matchesSet(name, CATEGORIES[cat])
end

-- =========================================================
-- ITEM LOGIC
-- =========================================================
local moved = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local npcCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    moved = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
end)

local function getHRP()
    local c = lp.Character
    return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

-- true if this belongs to a player or an NPC/animal (anything with a Humanoid)
local function isLiving(inst)
    local cached = npcCache[inst]
    if cached ~= nil then return cached end
    local result = false
    -- player characters (yours and others')
    if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(inst) or inst:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model") and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(inst:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")) then
        result = true
    end
    local char = lp.Character
    if char and (inst == char or inst:IsDescendantOf(char)) then result = true end
    -- NPCs, animals, pets, followers: anything rigged or animated
    local m = inst:IsA("Model") and inst or inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    local depth = 0
    while not result and m and m ~= workspace and depth < 6 do
        if m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            or m:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController")
            or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Motor6D", true)
            or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator", true) then
            result = true
            break
        end
        m = m:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        depth += 1
    end
    -- things attached to or chasing a character (pets, companions)
    if not result then
        local parts = inst:IsA("BasePart") and { inst } or inst:GetDescendants()
        for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                for _, j in ipairs(p:GetJoints()) do
                    local other = (j.Part0 == p) and j.Part1 or j.Part0
                    if other and other:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                        and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(other:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")) then
                        result = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AlignPosition") or p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BodyPosition")
                    or p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BodyGyro") or p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AlignOrientation") then
                    result = true
                end
            end
            if result then break end
        end
    end
    npcCache[inst] = result
    return result
end

local function isMovable(d)
    if d:IsA("BasePart") then
        return (S.includeAnchored or not d.Anchored) and d.Size.Magnitude <= MAX_ITEM_SIZE
    end
    if d:GetExtentsSize().Magnitude > MAX_ITEM_SIZE then return false end
    if S.includeAnchored then return true end
    for _, p in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and not p.Anchored then return true end
    end
    return false
end

-- if a parent Model already matches, we move that Model instead of its parts
local function ancestorModelMatches(d, matcher)
    local m = d.Parent
    while m and m ~= workspace do
        if m:IsA("Model") and matcher(m.Name) then return true end
        m = m.Parent
    end
    return false
end

local function itemPosition(d)
    return d:IsA("Model") and d:GetPivot().Position or d.Position
end

-- extra text a game may use to label an item (ProximityPrompt text, Attributes)
local labelCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local function labelText(d)
    local cached = labelCache[d]
    if cached then return cached end
    local parts = {}
    for _, c in ipairs(d:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or c:IsA("ClickDetector") then
            if c:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
                parts[#parts + 1] = c.ObjectText
                parts[#parts + 1] = c.ActionText
            end
        elseif c:IsA("StringValue") then
            parts[#parts + 1] = c.Value
        end
    end
    for _, key in ipairs({ "ItemName", "Item", "Name", "DisplayName", "Type" }) do
        local v = d:GetAttribute(key)
        if type(v) == "string" then parts[#parts + 1] = v end
    end
    local text = table.concat(parts, " ")
    labelCache[d] = text
    return text
end

local function isVisible(d)
    if d:IsA("BasePart") then return d.Transparency < 0.9 end
    for _, p in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Transparency < 0.9 then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function isCandidate(d, matcher, hrpPos)
    if moved[d] then return false end
    if EXCLUDED[d.Name:lower()] then return false end
    if not (matcher(d.Name) or matcher(labelText(d))) then return false end
    if isLiving(d) then return false end
    if ancestorModelMatches(d, matcher) then return false end
    if not isMovable(d) then return false end
    if not isVisible(d) then return false end
    if (itemPosition(d) - hrpPos).Magnitude < SKIP_NEAR then return false end
    return true
end

local function moveItem(item, cf)
    return pcall(function()
        if item:IsA("Model") then
            item:PivotTo(cf)
            for _, p in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                    p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    p.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end
            end
        else
            item.CFrame = cf
            item.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            item.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
    end)
end

-- Let the executor give us physics ownership of nearby parts (if supported)
pcall(function()
    if sethiddenproperty then
        sethiddenproperty(lp, "SimulationRadius", math.huge)
        sethiddenproperty(lp, "MaxSimulationRadius", math.huge)
    end
end)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------
-- INDEX: scan the workspace once, then keep it updated with events,
-- so we never re-walk every descendant on each bring / auto tick.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------
local idxList, idxSet = {}, setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local idxReady, idxBuilding = false, false

local function indexAdd(d)
    if (d:IsA("Model") or d:IsA("BasePart")) and not idxSet[d] then
        idxSet[d] = true
        idxList[#idxList + 1] = d
    end
end

workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(indexAdd)

local function ensureIndex()
    if idxReady then return end
    if idxBuilding then
        while not idxReady do task.wait(0.1) end
        return
    end
    idxBuilding = true
    local n = 0
    for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        indexAdd(d)
        n += 1
        if n % 2000 == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
    idxReady, idxBuilding = true, false
end

-- iterate the index in small slices, dropping destroyed instances
local function forEachIndexed(fn)
    ensureIndex()
    local write = 0
    local read = 0
    local total = #idxList
    while read < total do
        read += 1
        local d = idxList[read]
        if d.Parent then
            write += 1
            idxList[write] = d
            if fn(d) == false then
                -- stop early: keep the rest of the list intact
                for i = read + 1, total do
                    write += 1
                    idxList[write] = idxList[i]
                end
                read = total
            end
        end
        if read % 250 == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
    -- anything added while we yielded sits after `total`
    for i = total + 1, #idxList do
        write += 1
        idxList[write] = idxList[i]
    end
    for i = #idxList, write + 1, -1 do idxList[i] = nil end
end

local toCampfire = false
local function findCampfire()
    for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        local n = d.Name:lower()
        if n:find("campfire", 1, true) or n:find("bonfire", 1, true) or n:find("firepit", 1, true) or n:find("fire_pit", 1, true) then
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then return d end
            if d:IsA("Model") then
                local p = d.PrimaryPart or d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                if p then return p end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- where items land: next to you, or on top of the campfire
local function getTargetCF(hrp)
    if toCampfire then
        local cf = findCampfire()
        if cf then return cf.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, S.campOffset, 0), true end
    end
    return hrp.CFrame, false
end

local busy = false
local function bring(matcher, cap)
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return 0 end
    local brought = 0

    forEachIndexed(function(d)
        if brought >= cap then return false end
        local ok, good = pcall(isCandidate, d, matcher, hrp.Position)
        if ok and good then
            local base = getTargetCF(hrp)
            local offset = CFrame.new(math.random(-6, 6), 2, math.random(-6, 6))
            if moveItem(d, base * offset) then
                moved[d] = true
                brought += 1
            end
        end
    end)
    return brought
end

-- Brings every chest and lines them up in a grid in front of you
local function bringChestsInFront()
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return 0 end
    local matcher = function(name) return matchesCategory(name, "chests") end
    local hrpPos = hrp.Position

    local found = {}
    forEachIndexed(function(d)
        local ok, good = pcall(isCandidate, d, matcher, hrpPos)
        if ok and good then found[#found + 1] = d end
    end)

    local COLUMNS, SPACING, DISTANCE = 6, 6, 12
    local origin = hrp.CFrame
    local brought = 0
    for i, chest in ipairs(found) do
        local col = (i - 1) % COLUMNS
        local row = math.floor((i - 1) / COLUMNS)
        local x = (col - (COLUMNS - 1) / 2) * SPACING
        local z = -(DISTANCE + row * SPACING)
        -- ground-level spot in front of you, chest turned to face you
        local pos = (origin * CFrame.new(x, -2, z)).Position
        local cf = CFrame.lookAt(pos, Vector3.new(origin.Position.X, pos.Y, origin.Position.Z))
        if moveItem(chest, cf) then
            moved[chest] = true
            brought += 1
        end
        if i % 20 == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
    return brought
end


local function currentCap()
    local c = CAP_OPTIONS[S.capIndex]
    return S.perf and math.min(c, 50) or c
end

-- bring the N closest items of any category
local function bringNearest(count)
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return 0 end
    local matcher = function(name) return matchesCategory(name, "all") end
    local found = {}
    forEachIndexed(function(d)
        local ok, good = pcall(isCandidate, d, matcher, hrp.Position)
        if ok and good then
            found[#found + 1] = { inst = d, dist = (itemPosition(d) - hrp.Position).Magnitude }
        end
    end)
    table.sort(found, function(a, b) return a.dist < b.dist end)
    local brought = 0
    for i = 1, math.min(count, #found) do
        local base = getTargetCF(hrp)
        local offset = CFrame.new(math.random(-6, 6), 2, math.random(-6, 6))
        if moveItem(found[i].inst, base * offset) then
            moved[found[i].inst] = true
            brought += 1
        end
    end
    return brought
end

local function makeDraggable(object)
	local dragging = false
	local dragStart
	local startPosition

	object.InputBegan:Connect(function(inputObject)
		if inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = true
			dragStart = inputObject.Position
			startPosition = object.Position

			inputObject.Changed:Connect(function()
				if inputObject.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inputObject)
		if not dragging then
			return
		end

		if inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			or inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			local delta = inputObject.Position - dragStart

			object.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPosition.X.Scale,
				startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPosition.Y.Scale,
				startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end)
end
